Key Responsibilities Write blogs, landing pages, website copy, and product-related content for the global website while ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and marketing objectives. Research industry trends, competitor content, and fintech-related topics to create relevant content pieces and PR articles. Proofread and edit content for grammar, readability, clarity, and consistency while maintaining high-quality standards. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop campaigns, messaging, and SEO-optimized content based on keyword strategies and recommendations. Simplify complex financial and payment-related concepts into engaging and easy-to-understand content while maintaining consistency in brand tone across all channels. Support product launches, campaigns, and customer education initiatives while meeting content deadlines effectively. Skills & Qualifications Strong written and spoken English communication skills with the ability to create high-quality website content. Basic understanding of SEO-compliant writing and content optimization strategies. Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote team environment while adhering to deadlines and participating in productive discussions. Flexibility in writing style to align with existing brand language guidelines and the ability to independently edit and proofread content for grammar, readability, and conciseness. Strong research skills with the ability to stay updated on industry-related topics and trends to enhance content quality. Minimum 2–3+ years of experience in creating website content, including personal blogs or non-academic writing experience. Knowledge of Google Docs and familiarity with using AI tools to improve content operations. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment. Our Culture At Volopay, you'll thrive among passionate, talented individuals who bring their energy into everything they do. Our team's diversity is our strength, with musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and more contributing their unique talents. Picture a workplace that's not just about work, but about a shared journey. title: Customer Success Manager - India
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Client Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for designated Saa S and enterprise client accounts, fostering strong relationships and ensuring client satisfaction through timely and effective communication. Intercom Management: Oversee the Intercom platform to respond to customer inquiries, provide technical support, and address product-related questions or concerns in a timely and professional manner. Issue Resolution: Work closely with internal teams and external product/service providers to resolve customer queries, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure timely resolution to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. Process Development: Develop and implement efficient and scalable processes for managing customer support inquiries, including ticket management, escalation procedures, and knowledge base documentation. Team Leadership: Eventually lead, mentor, and coach the customer support team members, providing guidance, feedback, and support to ensure high performance and continuous improvement. Training and Onboarding: Develop comprehensive training materials and onboarding processes for new customer support team members, facilitating their integration into the team and ensuring alignment with service standards. Performance Monitoring: Monitor key performance metrics such as revenue growth of existing business. Once there is a team, also to measure response times, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores, and take proactive measures to address any areas for improvement. Skills & Qualification Open to both freshers and experienced candidates. We are looking for someone who is quick to learn, adaptable, and able to work with minimal supervision. Prior experience in customer service or fintech is a plus but not mandatory. Intercom Expertise: Proficiency in using Intercom or similar customer support platforms to manage and respond to customer inquiries efficiently. Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Leadership Abilities: Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire, and develop team members to achieve their full potential. Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving customer issues. Process Orientation: Experience in developing and implementing scalable processes and procedures to optimize customer support operations. Collaborative Nature: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product development, sales, and marketing, to address customer needs and drive customer success. Flexibility to support the UK market. Benefits: Competitive salary with performance-based incentives. Comprehensive benefits package including your health insurance. Remote work flexibility with a supportive and collaborative team environment. Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Our Culture At Volopay, you'll thrive among passionate, talented individuals who bring their energy into everything they do. Our team's diversity is our strength, with musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and more contributing their unique talents. Picture a workplace that's not just about work, but about a shared journey. We value your independence and trust you with tasks, encouraging you to take ownership and find innovative solutions. Our culture is rooted in: Ownership: We believe in freedom with responsibility. You'll naturally take the lead and excel. Results: We're doers who overcome obstacles with a can-do attitude. Curiosity: Curious minds thrive here. Wear multiple hats and embrace new challenges. Join our team and lead our customer support efforts to deliver exceptional service and drive customer satisfaction. If you are a proactive problem-solver with a passion for customer success and a desire to make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you. Apply now to become our Customer Success Manager and play a key role in shaping the future of our customer support operations. title: Senior RoR Developer
jobDescription: Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable Ruby on Rails applications and their APIs. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following best practices ( RSpec , Minitest , etc.). Apply TDD (Test-Driven Development) principles to ensure code reliability and quality. Optimize application performance and ensure responsiveness. Perform code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices. Debug production issues and provide timely fixes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently. Lead or mentor junior developers — experience in leading a team is a plus. Requirements Minimum 2 years of hands-on coding experience with Ruby on Rails. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field is preferred. Self-taught developers are also welcome. Strong understanding of software design patterns, RESTful API design, and version control systems (e.g., Git). Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver high-quality solutions within deadlines. Strong communication and collaboration skills. title: SEO Analyst
jobDescription: Volopay is looking for an SEO & Growth Manager to own organic growth end-to-end — from technical health and content strategy to team management and revenue impact. This isn't a role for someone who just wants rankings to go up; we need someone who connects SEO work to pipeline, works the numbers, and pushes the team to figure out what's actually driving (or blocking) growth. What You'll Do Own the organic growth strategy — technical SEO, content, and authority-building — and translate it into a working roadmap, not just a wishlist Manage and mentor a team of content writers — set priorities, review quality, keep output on schedule Diagnose why pages aren't ranking or converting, and fix the root cause instead of surface symptoms Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that track what matters — rankings, organic traffic, and lead quality and conversion, not just vanity metrics Partner closely with the sales team to understand where leads come from, how they convert, and feed that back into content and targeting decisions Use AI tools (Claude, Chat GPT, or similar) to automate repetitive SEO work — content gap analysis, reporting, rank tracking, audits — so the team spends time on strategy, not busywork Run regular technical and content audits and flag/prioritize issues before they cost rankings Stay ahead of how search itself is changing — AI answer engines, SGE/AI Overviews, changing SERP behavior — and adjust strategy accordingly, not just chase traditional rankings What We're Looking For Strong, demonstrated SEO skill — technical, content, and off-page — you can show us, not just tell us Genuinely comfortable with data — you look at numbers before you have opinions, and you can build a dashboard or read Ahrefs/GSC/GA data without hand-holding Can direct AI tools to do real work — not copy-paste, but actually prompt, iterate, and get usable output out of Claude/Chat GPT for research, reporting, or automation Strategic thinker — you can go from "traffic is flat" to a prioritized 90-day plan without someone spelling out each step Comfortable managing people — giving feedback, holding deadlines, unblocking a writer who's stuck Confident working cross-functionally — you're not intimidated by sitting across from sales and defending your numbers Self-driven — you learn new tools and SEO shifts on your own, you don't wait to be trained Nice to Have Experience in fintech, Saa S, or B2B — understanding how organic content maps to a longer B2B sales cycle Familiarity with tools like Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or similar Apply Autofill from resume Drag & drop or upload to autofill your application. Upload file First Name * ​ Last Name * ​ Email * ​ Linked In Profile URL * ​ Phone Number ​ How many years of hands-on SEO experience do you have? * ​ What is your current notice period? * ​ What is your current total annual compensation (CTC)? * ​ What is your expected total annual compensation ? * ​ Have you worked in a B2B Saa S or product-led company before? * ​ Resume * Drag and drop file or browse computer (PDF, 5 MB maximum) Apply Jobs powered by By applying you agree to Dover's terms . tag. To begin the development, run `npm start` or `yarn start`. To create a production bundle, use `npm run build` or `yarn build`. -->
